paragraphs: The morning meeting assigns work orders and reviews safety. Supervisors patrol sites and monitor progress, lead emergency repairs when faults occur, organize spare parts at midday, and conduct performance training in the afternoon. Before leaving, they review the shift and prepare the night crew.
